title: NutritionLabelResult
description: Structured output requested from the AI vision provider when it reads a nutrition facts table. A transcription: values exactly as printed, absent when not visible. The backend validates every field again and normalizes to 100 g.

found.description: False when the photo shows no readable nutrition table; everything else is then omitted.

basis.description: What the printed numbers are for. Required when found is true.

servingSizeG.description: Serving size in grams or millilitres. Required for per_serving.
